title: Étale descent and persistence on one affine triple
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preordered set, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and $c$ a limiting cone with apex $S$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i_0\in I$, schemes $X_0,Y_0$ over $S_{i_0}$ [def-pc-scheme], and an $S_{i_0}$-morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $W\subseteq S_{i_0}$, $V\subseteq Y_0$, $U\subseteq X_0$ be affine opens with $V\subseteq g_0^{-1}(W)$ and $U\subseteq f_0^{-1}(V)$, where $g_0:Y_0\to S_{i_0}$ is the structure map. Write $X_T=X_0\times_{S_{i_0}}T$, $Y_T=Y_0\times_{S_{i_0}}T$, $f_T$ for the base changed map and $U_T$ for the inverse image of $U$ under $X_T\to X_0$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $U_S\hookrightarrow X_S\xrightarrow{f_S}Y_S$ is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism], then some $i\ge i_0$ has the following property: for every $j\ge i$ and every chosen proof $i_0\le j$, $U_{S_j}\hookrightarrow X_{S_j}\xrightarrow{f_{S_j}}Y_{S_j}$ is étale. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness is assumed.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-affine-chart-directed-ring-model] for the fixed affine triple. It supplies a directed ring system on the upper tail J = {i | i₀ ≤ i}, algebras B,C, a finitely presented algebra map φ, and the comparisons at the limit and at individual stages. Apply the limit equivalence to the hypothesis.
The upper tail is directed: an upper bound of a,b in I belongs to the tail since i₀ ≤ a ≤ bound. Its distinguished object is i₀.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-etale-ring-map] to F, B,C,φ and the transported limit étaleness. It gives i in J with the tensor-product map at i étale. The stage comparison from [lem-weil-pbc-affine-chart-directed-ring-model] gives étaleness of Uᵢ → Yᵢ.

For j ≥ i, the Over.pullback maps at i and j form cartesian squares with f₀. Cancel the lower square by pullback pasting to obtain a cartesian square between fⱼ and fᵢ. The projection a:Xⱼ→Xᵢ satisfies a ≫ prᵢ = prⱼ, so a⁻¹(Uᵢ)=Uⱼ. Paste the pullback square for restriction to Uᵢ with this square. This identifies Uⱼ→Yⱼ as the base change of Uᵢ→Yᵢ, hence it is étale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]. The composition equality of the transition morphisms is functoriality of D; choices of inequality proofs agree by proof irrelevance.
